_readme: KPIs used across the industry are reported weekly to AAR/STB. Domain-internal KPIs (e.g. specific engineering defect rates) are sourced individually; do not invent a metric name without a source.

domain_01_service_design.source: UP explicitly tied Unified Plan 2020 to a 60% OR goal by 2020 and a longer-term 55% target

domain_01_service_design.kpi: Car dwell / car classification events / locomotive power requirement
domain_01_service_design.source: named as explicit UP Unified Plan 2020 focus metrics

domain_02_dispatching.kpi: Train speed by train type / terminal dwell / cars online
domain_02_dispatching.source: STB's public weekly rail service performance data

domain_03_terminal_yard.kpi: Cars classified per day / cars per minute at the hump
domain_03_terminal_yard.source: Bailey Yard sorts ~3,000 cars/day at up to 4 cars/minute across its two humps
Bailey Yard averages ~139 trains per day

domain_04_crew_management.source: general_industry_knowledge — standard operating metric referenced across crew management vendor materials
explicitly named as a CrewPro function (tracking pending certification expirations)

domain_06_engineering.source: UP reports defects down approximately 85% over five years of its automated inspection program

domain_06_engineering.kpi: PTC initialization success rate / enroute cutout events
domain_06_engineering.source: general_industry_knowledge; FRA tracks PTC performance metrics under Part 236 Subpart I reporting requirements

domain_06_engineering.kpi: Train speed by train type / terminal dwell / cars online
domain_06_engineering.source: STB's public weekly rail service performance data — cross-domain metric, primary home is RR-01 Service Design, cited here only where Engineering slow orders affect it

domain_07_safety_regulatory.source: FRA 2025 data shows overall train accidents down 14% year-over-year, cited in trade coverage of the crew-size ruling

domain_08_hazmat_environmental.source: app serves 2.3M+ first responders across 49 states, DC, and 8 Canadian provinces

domain_11_interline_equipment.source: over 2 million pieces of equipment registered, with less than 1% error rate

domain_11_interline_equipment.kpi: Daily trains interchanged at a gateway
domain_11_interline_equipment.source: UP/BNSF interchanged an average of 16 trains/day with Ferromex via Eagle Pass (Oct data); CPKC's Laredo-Nuevo Laredo crossing handled ~24 trains/day

domain_12_technology.kpi: Internal/external reporting measures driven by NetControl
domain_12_technology.source: NetControl's business logic drives 75 key internal and external reporting measures

domain_15_merger_integration.source: UP/NS merger application projects $133 million in annual capital synergies from combined network/fleet efficiency

not_yet_sourced_do_not_use: Any specific numeric target or threshold for the above KPIs at UP beyond what is explicitly cited — do not fabricate a number.

Domain 09, 10, 13, 14 KPIs — no company-specific sourcing found yet; do not populate with invented metrics. Use STB weekly performance measures (cross-referenced from RR-01/RR-02) as the only safe generic fallback for commercial/service metrics.
